dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}! It's great to see you here.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Let's have a drink to slake our thirsts. My treat!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: No need, just tell me whenever you need some refreshment!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How have you been recently?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Oh, neither good nor bad, really. But at least I no longer have any regrets.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Back when I was studying alchemy in Mondstadt, I believed that even overly-ordinary children like myself could reach our dreams.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: But as I studied, I realized that there are some gulfs that cannot be bridged, and some people who cannot be caught up to.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: That's when I realized that alchemy is really for those who either have immense talent or resources.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: The color of my dreams... they just weren't the same as theirs.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And that's why you joined the Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: *sigh* Well, I wasn't going to accept a lifetime of mediocrity, that's for sure. And I mean, there are those fated to do good, and those fated to do evil in this world, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you still believe that?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Heh. Alright... Stop scolding me, you're starting to sound like Jinwu. And yes, I know I was wrong...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Jinwu talked to me about this as well, and she had the right of it for sure...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: "Whether it's those who received the gods' favor, or those who are just lucky... They're like proud birds with their wings spread wide, living for themselves, looking far out into the distance."

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: "As for the places that they don't see, and the places they won't go, well, those are for people like us to build up, to watch over, to defend..."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It sure beats being a bandit and hurting others.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Yeah... Becoming a Treasure Hoarder and all that... all I did in chasing such selfish freedom was bringing misfortune on myself.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: And while the things we're doing right now are ordinary, they have impact beyond us or even people around us.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I mean... Someone's got to do this job, and we ordinary people just happen to be here, right?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Regardless, thank you both very much for helping me understand that ordinary work is not meaningless.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Phew, alright. Let's cut the chatter about pointless stuff. What say you to a drink? I've still got loads of "Real Man's Meds" on me, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on! Are you seriously still trying to sell us fake medicine?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I was sent up here by Jinwu. The Millelith might be sending a batch of blasting equipment over here soon, but she's busy at the campsite and can't leave at the moment.
